metric_explanations.adv_lookback_days: Trailing lookback window used to estimate dollar ADV.
metric_explanations.execution_days_cap: Maximum number of trading days allowed to work a rebalance for the heuristic capacity estimate.
metric_explanations.median_capacity_estimated_impact_bps: Modeled worst-name impact, in basis points, at the heuristic median capacity.

metric_explanations.p25_capacity_estimated_impact_bps: Modeled worst-name impact, in basis points, at the heuristic 25th percentile capacity.

metric_explanations.rebalance_observations: Number of rebalances contributing to the heuristic capacity estimate.
metric_explanations.worst_rebalance_capacity_estimated_impac: Modeled worst-name impact, in basis points, at the tightest heuristic rebalance capacity.
metric_explanations.worst_rebalance_capacity_usd: Tightest rebalance-level heuristic capacity observed in the sample.

metric_explanations.current_portfolio_size_usd: Portfolio size used for current-size impact diagnostics.
metric_explanations.current_size_vs_median_capacity: Ratio of the configured current portfolio size to the median impact-consistent capacity.
metric_explanations.current_worst_name_impact_bps_max: Maximum modeled worst-name impact, in basis points, at the configured current portfolio size.
metric_explanations.current_worst_name_impact_bps_median: Median modeled worst-name impact, in basis points, at the configured current portfolio size across rebalances.
metric_explanations.current_worst_name_impact_bps_p75: 75th percentile modeled worst-name impact, in basis points, at the configured current portfolio size.
metric_explanations.execution_delay_risk_coef: Multiplier on volatility risk accumulated while an order is worked.
metric_explanations.execution_max_days: Maximum number of days available to work each rebalance trade.
metric_explanations.execution_overflow_penalty_bps: Penalty applied to order value that cannot fit inside the participation and execution-day limits.
metric_explanations.execution_participation_rate: Maximum fraction of trailing ADV targeted per execution day.
metric_explanations.max_allowed_single_name_impact_bps: Maximum tolerated modeled impact, in basis points, for the worst traded name on a rebalance.

metric_explanations.p25_capacity_estimated_impact_bps: Modeled worst-name impact, in basis points, at the impact-model 25th percentile capacity.

metric_explanations.volume_impact_coef: Square-root market-impact coefficient used in the impact model.

factor_explanations.CMA: Conservative minus aggressive investment factor; positive indicates a tilt toward firms investing more conservatively.
factor_explanations.HML: High minus low value factor; positive indicates a value tilt, negative a growth tilt.
factor_explanations.LT_REV: Long-term reversal factor; positive indicates a tilt toward long-term losers rebounding.
factor_explanations.MOM: Momentum factor; positive indicates a tilt toward recent winners.
factor_explanations.RMW: Robust minus weak profitability factor; positive indicates a tilt toward more profitable firms.
factor_explanations.SMB: Small minus big size factor; positive indicates a tilt toward smaller companies.
factor_explanations.ST_REV: Short-term reversal factor; positive indicates a tilt toward short-term losers rebounding.

metric_explanations.alpha_annualized: Daily alpha scaled by observations per year; rough annualized residual return estimate.
metric_explanations.alpha_daily: Regression intercept in daily return units after controlling for the listed factors.
metric_explanations.betas: Factor sensitivities; positive means the strategy tends to rise when that factor rises, negative means the opposite.
metric_explanations.excess_return_regression: True when the dependent variable was strategy excess returns after subtracting the risk-free rate.
metric_explanations.factors_used: Factor columns that were present and actually used in the regression.
metric_explanations.observations: Number of aligned return observations used in the regression.
metric_explanations.r_squared: 0 to 1. Share of return variance explained by the regression factors.

metric_explanations.duration_days: Calendar days from the pre-drawdown peak to the recovery date.
metric_explanations.peak_date: Date of the equity peak immediately preceding the worst drawdown.
metric_explanations.recovery_date: First date the equity curve recovered to the prior peak; 'Not Recovered' if recovery never occurred in-sample.
metric_explanations.trough_date: Date of the deepest point of the worst drawdown.
metric_explanations.value: Most negative peak-to-trough drawdown observed over the analyzed period.

sector_neutrality.methodology: Estimated using current SEC SIC-derived sectors. Portfolio sector weights are compared with equal-weight eligible-universe sector weights on each rebalance.

metric_explanations.average_effective_sector_count: Diversification proxy equal to 1/HHI of mapped portfolio sector weights; higher means more even sector spread.
metric_explanations.average_mapped_portfolio_weight_ratio: 0 to 1. Average fraction of portfolio weight covered by the sector map.
metric_explanations.average_mapped_universe_name_ratio: 0 to 1. Average fraction of eligible universe names covered by the sector map.
metric_explanations.average_max_sector_abs_deviation: Average largest single-sector overweight or underweight versus the eligible universe.
metric_explanations.average_portfolio_sector_count: Average number of mapped sectors represented in the portfolio on a rebalance date.
metric_explanations.average_sector_active_share: 0 to 1. Average sector mismatch versus the equal-weight eligible universe; lower is more sector-neutral.
metric_explanations.average_universe_sector_count: Average number of mapped sectors represented in the eligible universe on a rebalance date.
metric_explanations.best_rebalance_date: Date with the lowest sector active share.
metric_explanations.best_sector_active_share: Lowest sector active share seen on any included rebalance date.
metric_explanations.median_sector_active_share: Median per-rebalance sector active share; less sensitive to outlier dates than the average.
metric_explanations.rebalance_observations: Number of rebalance dates included in the sector-neutrality estimate.
metric_explanations.top_average_portfolio_sectors: Largest average mapped portfolio sector weights across included rebalance dates.
metric_explanations.top_average_sector_overweights: Largest average positive portfolio-minus-universe sector tilts.
metric_explanations.top_average_sector_underweights: Largest average negative portfolio-minus-universe sector tilts.
metric_explanations.top_average_universe_sectors: Largest average equal-weight eligible-universe sector weights across included rebalance dates.
metric_explanations.worst_rebalance_date: Date with the highest sector active share.
metric_explanations.worst_sector_active_share: Highest sector active share seen on any included rebalance date.
